subject: Transient throughput elevation request and SLA appendix
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenline.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenline.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary rate elevation & SLA appendix

Hi Logan,

We run an annual capacity burst for our expedited routing pipeline the first weekend of September. Last year we hit throttles on several inference endpoints and had to reroute traffic, which cost us delays and manual ops.

Can Redwood provide a 72-hour elevated throughput window for the dates below and add a short SLA appendix that guarantees latency SLOs for inference calls for that window? Specifically:
- Elevated burst allowance to 3x our current rate-limit per second (we estimate 1,800 TPS peak).
- A latency target of p50 < 200ms and p95 < 700ms for token-generation requests during the window.
- A pre-authorized cap (spend cap) and an automatic rollback to standard fair-share policy if usage exceeds the cap.

We're prepared to sign a one-page addendum and provide a PO. I've attached our forecast and a short runbook. Can you confirm feasibility and any lead times?

Attachments:
- greenline_peak_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- runbook_peak_ops.md (doc referenced in Drive)

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
Greenline Logistics
Samantha.Lee@greenline.ai

----

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate elevation & SLA appendix

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and the forecast. We can support time-limited throughput adjustments, but I want to make sure we size this correctly and capture the controls both sides need. A few clarifying items: 

1) Traffic shape: is the 1,800 TPS peak a 5-minute sustained peak or an instantaneous burst? If you have minute-by-minute expected load, please attach.
2) Endpoints in scope: are these all inference text-generation endpoints under the account or a specific model route?
3) Spend cap: please confirm the maximum charge you're willing to pre-authorize for the 72-hour window — that helps us set the automatic rollback threshold.

Operationally, I'm looping in Marissa (commercial lead) and Karthik (solutions) so we can align pricing and the technical runbook. Preliminary position: we can grant a transient throughput elevation for a defined window with a signed addendum and a PO; during the window we will prioritize traffic per the addendum and commit to the latency targets where feasible, with an explicit fair-share fallback if the pre-authorized cap is reached.

I've attached a simple worksheet so you can confirm minute-level estimates: initial-traffic-estimate.xlsx

I'll coordinate to have a draft addendum ready by Monday for legal and procurement review. If you prefer a quick call, suggest Mon 08/24 10:00am PT.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenline.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate elevation & SLA appendix

Hi Samantha — looping in commercial to outline terms. Appreciate the forecast; this helps a lot. Summary of what we can offer and the commercial ask: 

- Window: 72 hours (specify start time).
- Throughput: temporary uplift to the requested rate (3x current limit) for the named endpoints.
- Latency SLOs: we will target p50 < 200ms and p95 < 700ms for the specified model routes during the window; these are operational targets and will be captured in the addendum language as "targeted SLOs" with a carveout for dependence on underlying public cloud availability and shared hardware variance.
- Controls: a pre-authorized spend cap (you confirm amount) that, if reached, triggers automated rollback to baseline fair-share throttling. We'll also require a short testing window (30–60 minutes) before the start to prime caches and KV state.

Commercial: for a 72-hour transient throughput addendum we propose a one-time uplift fee of USD 18,000 plus overage billing at the standard pay-as-you-go rates. If you opt for a Reserved burst commitment we can reduce the one-time uplift.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm minute-level traffic estimate and the PO cap.
2) We share a one-page transient-throughput-addendum-draft.pdf for signature (DocuSign) and a quick runbook checklist.
3) Sign PO and addendum; we execute a 30–60 min warm-up window ahead of the start time.

I'm attaching the draft addendum for your review. If that looks ok we can route DocuSign and get procurement's PO.

Attachments:
- transient-throughput-addendum-draft.pdf (PDF)

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning?token=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/52345/GL-2026-087

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenline.ai>

Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@greenline.ai>, procurement@greenline.ai
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate elevation & SLA appendix

Thanks Logan and Marissa — that all sounds good. We can confirm the following: 
- Peak shape: the 1,800 TPS is a 5-minute sustained peak with several 30s spikes up to ~2,100 TPS. I've uploaded a minute-level CSV to the Drive link and attached the high-level forecast here (greenline_peak_forecast.xlsx).
- Endpoints: all inference calls routed to /v1/models/route-prod-* are in scope.
- PO cap: Greenline will pre-authorize USD 25,000 for the 72-hour window. If we approach the cap we'll notify ops and let the automated rollback occur.

We'll review the draft addendum and sign via DocuSign today. I'll also get procurement to return the PO PDF — attaching a signed PO stub for now.

Attachments:
- greenline_peak_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- greenline_po_signed.pdf (PO stub)

Can we schedule the 30–60 minute warm-up on Fri 09/03 09:00am PT? If so we'll lock the start window at 00:00 PT on Sat 09/04.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samantha Lee
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
Greenline Logistics
Samantha.Lee@greenline.ai
